import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem hockey_stick_binomial (n k : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), Nat.choose i k) = Nat.choose (n + 1) (k + 1) := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      by_cases hk : k = 0
      · simp [hk]
      · have hk0 : 0 < k := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk
        have hk1 : 1 < k + 1 := by
          simpa using Nat.succ_lt_succ hk0
        simp [hk, hk0, hk1, Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt]
  | succ n ih =>
      calc
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range ((n + 1) + 1), Nat.choose i k)
            = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), Nat.choose i k) + Nat.choose (n + 1) k := by
              simpa using (Finset.sum_range_succ (fun i : ℕ => Nat.choose i k) (n + 1))
        _ = Nat.choose (n + 1) (k + 1) + Nat.choose (n + 1) k := by
              simpa [ih]
        _ = Nat.choose ((n + 1) + 1) (k + 1) := by
              simpa [Nat.add_comm] using (Nat.choose_succ_succ (n + 1) k).symm

        simp_all [Nat.choose_succ_succ]
    })
    <;>
    (try {
      induction k <;> simp_all [Nat.choose_succ_succ]
      <;> ring_nf at * <;> omega
    })
  
  have h_inductive_step : ∀ (n : ℕ), (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), Nat.choose i k) = Nat.choose (n + 1) (k + 1) → (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1 + 1), Nat.choose i k) = Nat.choose (n + 1 + 1) (k + 1) := by
    intro n ih
    have h₁ : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1 + 1), Nat.choose i k) = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), Nat.choose i k) + Nat.choose (n + 1) k := by
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ]
      <;> simp [add_assoc]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> simp_all [Finset.sum_range_succ, add_assoc]
      <;> linarith
    rw [h₁]
    have h₂ : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), Nat.choose i k) = Nat.choose (n + 1) (k + 1) := ih
    rw [h₂]
    have h₃ : Nat.choose (n + 1) (k + 1) + Nat.choose (n + 1) k = Nat.choose (n + 1 + 1) (k + 1) := by
      have h₄ : Nat.choose (n + 1) (k + 1) + Nat.choose (n + 1) k = Nat.choose (n + 1 + 1) (k + 1) := by
        rw [← Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_pos (by linarith : 0 < n + 1 + 1)]

        <;> ring_nf at *
        <;> simp_all [Nat.choose_succ_succ, add_comm, add_assoc, add_left_comm]
        <;> linarith
      exact h₄
    rw [h₃]
    <;> simp [add_assoc]
    <;> ring_nf
    <;> simp_all [Finset.sum_range_succ, add_assoc]
    <;> linarith
  
  have h_main : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), Nat.choose i k) = Nat.choose (n + 1) (k + 1) := by
    have h : ∀ n : ℕ, (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), Nat.choose i k) = Nat.choose (n + 1) (k + 1) := by
      intro n
      induction n with

      | succ n ih =>

        simpa [Finset.sum_range_succ, add_assoc] using h₁
    
    have h₂ := h n
    simpa using h₂
  
  apply h_main

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem hockey_stick_binomial (n k : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), Nat.choose i k) = Nat.choose (n + 1) (k + 1) := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      cases k <;> simp [Nat.choose]
  | succ n ih =>
      calc
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (Nat.succ n + 1), Nat.choose i k) =
            (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), Nat.choose i k) +
              Nat.choose (n + 1) k := by
                rw [show Nat.succ n + 1 = (n + 1) + 1 by omega]
                rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
        _ = Nat.choose (n + 1) (k + 1) + Nat.choose (n + 1) k := by
              rw [ih]
        _ = Nat.choose (n + 1) k + Nat.choose (n + 1) (k + 1) := by
              exact Nat.add_comm _ _
        _ = Nat.choose ((n + 1) + 1) (k + 1) := by
              symm
              apply Nat.choose_succ_succ
